title: Warmly Roasted Thai King Prawns Gaeng Curry
description: A light and crispy Thai dish featuring raw king prawns in a gaeng curry sauce, served in a corn husk wrap. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, gaeng curry paste, fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar, and blend until smooth.
Add the raw king prawns to the curry sauce and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Wrap each corn husk in foil and roast in the oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned and fragrant.
Remove the corn husks from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Add the marinated king prawns to the roasted corn husks and wrap securely.
Drizzle the tops with vegetable oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Return the wrapped king prawns to the oven and roast for an additional 8-10 minutes, or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Remove the king prawns from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the warmly roasted Thai king prawns gaeng curry in the corn husk wraps, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
